Put your copy of Doom RPG (the phone game, DoomRPG.jar) in this folder.

When the Deimos Editor starts, it looks here for it. If it isn't here, the
editor asks where it is, and puts a copy here so it finds it next time.

The editor contains nothing of the original game: it makes the maps, the art,
the texts and the sounds from your DoomRPG.jar.
